label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Dear everyone,

This is for my friends, my neighbours, the Little Acorns families and whoever else ends up reading it. Please forward it to anyone who has been asking about me. My phone has not stopped since Saturday and I can't answer everyone one by one, so I'd rather you all hear it from me once, properly.

The first thing to know is that I'm safe. I'm staying with my sister in Rondebosch, and Marmalade is with me.

WHAT HAPPENED

This is the short version, because I don't want to go through all of it again.

On Saturday night, 7 November, at about 11:40pm, a fire started in a ground floor flat at Lindale Court on Station Road in Observatory. I live on the second floor, in flat 12, and I was asleep. I woke up because my neighbour, Uncle Faizel, was banging on every door on our floor in his vest and slippers. I grabbed my phone and my cat and nothing else.

Everyone in all 14 flats got out. Two people were treated for smoke at Groote Schuur and sent home.

The fire department says it was probably an electrical fault, but they are still investigating. I'm not going to guess, and I'd ask you not to either.

My flat is basically gone. There is smoke and water everywhere and the ceiling came down in the lounge. The landlord says nobody will be allowed back in for at least six weeks.

Marmalade hid under the car for two hours afterwards. Furniture can be replaced. Marmalade can't.

THE FUNDRAISER, AND THE ONE THAT IS NOT MINE

Please read this part even if you skip the rest.

My friend Zinhle set up a BackaBuddy page for me. This is the only fundraiser that has anything to do with me:

backabuddy.example/thandi-lindale-court

The target is R25 000 and it was already at R11 400 when I wrote this, which I still can't quite believe.

There is also a page going around called "Thandi Fire Relief" on a different site, and a WhatsApp message asking people to EFT money to a Capitec account. Neither of those is me or Zinhle. I have reported it. Please don't send money to it and please don't forward it. If someone sends it to you, tell them it's fake and send them this letter instead.

If it isn't the BackaBuddy link above, it isn't mine.

I hate asking for help, and honestly I feel weird about there being a fundraiser at all. When I told Zinhle that, she told me to shut up and accept it. So I'm accepting it, and I'm very grateful to her and to every one of you who has given.

WHAT I NEED

- Help with the deposit for a new place. This is the big one, and the BackaBuddy page is the way to help with it.
- Shoes for school, size 6, and work clothes, size 34.
- A laptop, if anyone has an old one that still works. All my lesson planning was on mine.

If you have shoes, work clothes or a laptop, send me a message. I will get back to you, it just might take me a few days.

WHAT I DON'T NEED

- More clothes in general. I've been given far more than I can wear and I'll be passing the extras on to the other flats.
- Food. My sister's freezer is full.

I know people want to do something and these are the easiest things to bring. I love you for it, but I'd hate for it to go to waste.

FOR THE LADYBIRDS PARENTS

For anyone who doesn't know me from school, I teach the Ladybirds, the Grade 00 class at Little Acorns Pre-Primary in Mowbray. They are four and five years old.

The end of year concert on 27 November is still happening. I had taken things home to laminate, so the 22 crowns and the children's handprint banner were in the flat and they are gone. Please don't worry about this. The Ladybirds will have crowns.

I'm back at school on Wednesday. Please don't make a big thing of it in front of the children. I'd like it to feel like an ordinary day for them, and for me too.

THANK YOU

People have been amazing. I have cried at every single message.

Uncle Faizel, I woke up because of you. I don't know how to thank you for that, so I'm starting by telling everyone.

One of the moms from my class left a bag of clothes on my sister's gate at 7 on Sunday morning. She didn't even knock, she just left it there for me to find. I will remember that for a very long time.

And Zinhle, who didn't wait for me to ask, because she knew I wouldn't.

I am reading everything, but I'm very tired and I'm replying to comments slowly. Please don't be offended if I don't answer your DM. It doesn't mean I didn't see it or that it didn't matter to me.

With love and so much gratitude,

Thandi (and Marmalade)

---

Two things to check before you send it:

- **Wednesday:** today is Wednesday the 11th, so if you mean next week, change it to "Wednesday 18 November" so nobody is confused.
- **The deposit:** I assumed the BackaBuddy money is going towards it. If Zinhle's page says something different, tweak that line.
